actions.name: editMarkSelection
actions.summary: Replaces the complete selector while preserving the stored selection ID and mark target.
useWhen: Use this action when you need to replace the complete selector while preserving the stored selection ID and mark target.
avoidWhen: Avoid this action before the owned resource exists or when more than one compatible target remains unnamed; create or target it explicitly first.
requiredState: The exact existing owned resource must be present and uniquely inferable, or the action must receive its explicit target identifier.

semantic: Replaces the complete selector while preserving the stored selection ID and mark target. The changed semantic owner or assignment is structurally copied into the returned program.
graphic: Materializes or rematerializes the affected backend-neutral graphical subtree when the required semantic state is complete.

notes: Compose this action only after its required state is unambiguous; use explicit public identifiers when several compatible resources exist.

commonErrors.problem: Calling the action without an existing unique owner causes a missing-target or ambiguous-target error.
commonErrors.fix: Pass the exact public identifier required by the signature, or create the missing prerequisite before calling this action.

actions.name: filterMarks
actions.summary: Retains matching final mark items through the shared selector grammar, create one namespaced immutable member row dataset, rebind the mark, and rematerialize its scales and connected guides without changing the source.
useWhen: Use this action when you need to retain matching final mark items through the shared selector grammar, create one namespaced immutable member row dataset, rebind the mark, and rematerialize its scales and connected guides without changing the source.
avoidWhen: Avoid this action when downstream transforms must consume filtered rows; use filterData to create a reusable derived dataset instead.
requiredState: A materialized compatible mark must exist so selection predicates can be evaluated against final semantic and graphical items.

parameterNotes.description: Names the exact existing resource to change when current state does not identify one unique compatible target.

actions.name: highlightMarks
